description: Search Reddit posts globally or within a subreddit using boolean keywords/brand mentions and optional ?since= Unix timestamp polling. Charges 0 Credits when 0 posts match! Cost: 1 Credit ($0.0001) per matched post.

query.description: Search keyword or boolean query (e.g. "supabase OR clerk")

since.description: Optional Unix epoch seconds filter for incremental brand monitoring

subreddit.description: Optional subreddit filter without r/ prefix

name: reddit_posts_search
